summary.text: Mark Higley is a Republican state representative from the Orleans-Lamoille district who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2009 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026; he is also on the ballot as a Democratic candidate, having advanced from both parties' August 11 primaries.

paragraphs.text: Mark Higley earned a high school diploma, has served in the United States Navy, and has worked as a general contractor.
He served as a selectman for the Town of Brattleboro from 1997 to 1998.
Higley assumed office in the Vermont House in 2009.
Ballotpedia lists his 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 committee assignments as the House Government Operations Committee and the Legislative Committee on Administrative Rules.
